program.name: Kapukai Program Architecture
program.statement: KES governs the program; AIM discovers mechanics; ACA standardizes validated mechanics; KAPU evaluates; EDS makes decisions observable; humans retain authority.

items.name: KAPU Evaluation Engine
items.description: Formal evaluation capability; ACA Verify is tracked separately as a bounded declared-predicate interpreter.

items.name: Decision Replay Explorer
items.description: Merged into main after acceptance; compares supplied Decision Proof Records and exposes divergence.

items.name: Release Pipeline
items.description: Merged into main through the canonical KES-0003 integration candidate.

items.name: Repository Intelligence
items.description: Merged into main with KES-0002 through PR #5.

items.name: Mission Control
items.description: Read-only program control plane merged into main through PR #6.

items.name: Standards Registry and Work Orchestration
items.description: Deterministic ACA identifier registry, agent proposal boundary, and governed work-package contract merged through PR #12.

items.name: ACA Verify Declared-Predicate Interpreter
items.description: Merged candidate partial-profile interpreter; it evaluates supplied declarations and does not independently establish facts, artifact bindings, legality, or authority.
items.blocking_reason: Active safety hold: no release, tag, deployment, pilot, marketing, real-case use, or consequential reliance pending hardening and human IP, licensing, security, claims, and release review.

items.name: Authority Integrity Mechanics Program Charter
items.description: Research charter, construct register, promotion gates, and safety boundary merged through PR #7.

items.name: Authority Integrity Mechanics Measurement Primitives
items.description: Operational definitions, units, observation rules, and falsification tests for candidate mechanics.
items.blocking_reason: Eligible only after AIM-0000 human acceptance.

items.name: Human Authorization
items.description: Draft human authorization architecture remains separate from verification and awaits human review in PR #8.
items.blocking_reason: Draft PR requires architecture review and explicit human acceptance before merge.

risks.title: Ambiguous branch disposition
risks.containment: KES-0002, KES-0003, and KES-0004 are merged into protected main through PRs #5 and #6; future work uses explicit feature branches and pull requests.

risks.title: Verification confused with authorization
risks.containment: Maintain separate fields and gates for verification, acceptance, authorization, publication, and release.

risks.title: Research claims promoted prematurely
risks.containment: AIM-0000 defines AIM as non-normative and requires reproducibility, adversarial review, expert review, misuse review, and a separate ACA standardization decision.

risks.title: Agent-generated ACA identifier collision
risks.containment: KES-0005 makes the registry authoritative, prohibits agent allocation, validates decade parentage, and requires human acceptance.

risks.title: Candidate verifier overclaim
risks.containment: ACA Verify is labeled as a declared-predicate partial-profile interpreter; reliance remains NOT_ESTABLISHED; an active safety hold blocks release and real-case use.

risks.title: Unresolved public licensing and patent boundary
risks.containment: No release tag, deployment, pilot, or external adoption claim until human intellectual-property and licensing review is recorded.

next_authorized_work.reason: KES-0005 and AIM-0000 are accepted; the next architectural gate is the explicit human authorization layer in draft PR #8.
